items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Smitty on piano. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Joe Morris used to play with us too, with Kid Sheik.

ctx.x: When I came back from California. When I went back with Sheik. Uh-huh. When I played different job, spot job with other bands. Yeah.

But Sheik was my regular band. Who did you have with that band? I mean, uh, do you remember the men, when Eddie came back? Whenever did get that strike, who would have been in your band when Eddie came back? That's after you came out. Oh, yeah. Well, we was using most of the time, and Howard was in with us. Howard was in with us. Yeah. Howard was in with us. Yeah. So, that'd be Sheik. Eddie Summers, Howard, Thang. Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, who I was talking about. Big was, you, Big Art. Big Art. Big Art. Big Art on…

Yeah. Joe Morris used to play with us too, with Kid Sheik. Yeah. When was that? Early or was that? That was back in 1948, wasn't it? When Joe Morris was playing. Remember when we used to play by Miss Bessie?
